chunks: From him, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

If the woman becomes pure before sunset, then she should perform the ẓuhr and the ʿaṣr salat (prayer); and if she becomes pure at the end of the night, then she should perform the maghrib and the ʿishāʾ salat (prayer).

key_terms.آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ: the end portion of the night before its time expires
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ: sunset, marking the end of the daytime prayer window mentioned here

ai.seo_question: What salat (prayer) must a woman perform if she becomes pure from menstruation before sunset or at the end of the night?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman who becomes pure before the end of the prayer times. It states that if her purity returns before sunset, she performs ẓuhr and ʿaṣr, and if it returns at the end of the night, she performs maghrib and ʿishāʾ.
